facts.text: Nebraska Promise covers all remaining tuition costs for eligible students with family income of $65,000 or less or who receive a Pell Grant.

sources.title: Nebraska Promise | Admissions | University of Nebraska at Omaha
sources.quote: If you are eligible for a Federal Pell Grant or have Family income of $65,000 or less (Adjusted Gross Income or AGI), Nebraska Promise will cover all your remaining tuition costs
